changes: Create or reconcile exactly two marker-owned single-tenant registrations: staff API and secretless native/public token client.
Create or reconcile their same-tenant, marker-owned service principals with appRoleAssignmentRequired true.
Expose only access_as_user delegated scope on the API, request v2 access tokens, and define Manager/Host/Server/Kitchen plus Floor.1-Floor.5 user app roles.

Set API identifier URI using its actual generated client ID. Configure public-client localhost redirect and only this API's delegated scope. No API web redirect or runtime hostname is required for this token-based staff UI.
No password, certificate, Graph application permission, preauthorization, tenant-wide admin consent, user/group creation or automatic manager assignment is performed.

Later authorized staff assignment uses POST /servicePrincipals/{actual-api-sp-id}/appRoleAssignedTo for the approved user's business role plus floor roles (Manager already spans all floors). Assign the same approved user to the native-client principal using its default access role. Unassigned users remain denied.
Tenant-permitted delegated consent for the scenario API scope is separate; no oauth2PermissionGrant is automatically created.

permissionRequirements.applicationCreate: Current Graph v1.0 documents AppRegistration.Create as least privilege; tenant member creation policy or Application Developer capability still applies.
permissionRequirements.applicationReadUpdate: Delegated Application.ReadWrite.All plus effective ownership/tenant capability; application-only Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy may be an approved installer alternative, not selected automatically.
permissionRequirements.servicePrincipalCreateUpdate: Delegated Application.ReadWrite.All; current create documentation requires an Application Developer or supported scoped application-management role for owned single-tenant apps. Effective capabilities are not proven by Azure subscription Owner.
permissionRequirements.staffRoleAssignments: Separate AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All and Application.Read.All, with an effective supported Entra role/custom capability such as scoped application management. These are installer permissions only, never runtime application permissions.
permissionRequirements.delegatedConsent: Tenant user-consent policy may allow access_as_user; otherwise an authorized consent administrator must handle only the reviewed permission. No claim of tenant admin necessity without actual policy evidence.
permissionRequirements.quotaProviderRegistration: Microsoft.Resources/subscriptions/providers/register/action for Microsoft.Quota would be an additional subscription mutation, currently not authorized; it is not tooling installation and is not performed.

lifecycle: Present this exact directory/install scope, actual independent ARM preview, costs, missing quota facts and dependent checks in consolidated exact-target consent; do not execute from read-only preparation.
Only after separate recorded directory authorization, run setup_identity.py with the exact scope file and --authorize-directory-install. Errors stop execution; no permission fallback or elevation.

Installer discovers by stable name plus cryptographic target marker, rejects ambiguous/unowned registrations/principals, captures generated object/client IDs automatically after each step and verifies configured outputs.

After separately authorized shared-infrastructure provisioning, capture actual Foundry project endpoint, environment domain, managed identity IDs and exact per-environment Consumption usage. Require measured quota >= 28 rollout vCPU before app rollout; do not infer zero or a default quota.
Capture image digest and real agent versions through the existing publication/initializer sequence only within authorized scope.

prepare_runtime.py consumes --identity-receipt and actual infrastructure/initializer outputs; staff audience is generated, not user input. Optional legacy --audience can only match the generated audience.

azd predeploy hook exports generated STAFF_TENANT_ID/STAFF_AUDIENCE/STAFF_CLIENT_ID to the exact already-existing environment after scope verification. It performs no Graph call, initialization or cloud mutation.

Repreview dependent runtime/grants with actual outputs, refresh readiness and obtain any remaining exact-target rollout authorization before deployment. Run live sign-in, wrong-role, cross-floor, wrong-tenant and agent tests afterward.
limitations: Only offline installer tests ran. No Graph reads/writes or consent/role-assignment tests were authorized or executed.
Default-deny principal assignment remains pending until authorized staff installation; receipt installed=true means registrations verified, not staff login or end-to-end success.
No generated identity IDs or endpoints are requested from the user. Authorized human staff roster is distinct from installation-generated resource IDs.
No new installer route, administrator questionnaire or business decision is created.
